description: This file defines a static class 'CalculatorApp' that provides UI automation methods and properties for interacting with the Windows Calculator application during testing. It includes methods to retrieve header text, ensure focus, resize the window, and check for the presence of UI elements like the DockPanel.

classes.name: CalculatorApp
classes.description: A static class providing UI automation helpers for the Windows Calculator app during testing.

methods.name: GetCalculatorHeaderText
methods.description: Retrieves the text from the calculator's header UI element.

methods.name: EnsureCalculatorHasFocus
methods.description: Clicks on the AppName element to bring focus to the calculator application.

methods.name: ClickOnWindow
methods.description: Clicks on the main window to remove focus from other UI components.

methods.name: ResizeWindowToDisplayMemoryHistoryDockPanel
methods.description: Resizes the calculator window to ensure the DockPanel for History and Memory lists is visible.

methods.name: GrowWindowToShowDock
methods.description: Recursively increases window width until the DockPanel is detected or maximum width is exceeded.
